root_facts: One active scheduling root fact that can open, resolve and recur as an anomaly.
forbidden_direct_seed: Direct alert-state mutation outside the anomaly owner workflow.
commands: Open, owner-repair, and recur the scheduling root through the anomaly workflow.
receipt_requirements: The receipt records the same alert identity across open, resolve and reopen transitions.
expected: An active scheduling root opens an anomaly.
Manual resolve cannot erase a still-active root; owner repair auto-resolves it.
A recurrent root reopens the same alert with preserved timeline.
